biggest_catch: Berkeley Xlab's official FAQ pays by check directly after the experiment — genuinely same-day — but the amount is only an average: 'the average payment is $20 per hour of participation (however, this does NOT mean you are getting paid by the hour. Some participants may receive more, some may receive less).' An average is not a concrete payout.
catches: Payout is stated as an average ($20/hour), not a concrete per-study amount — 'some may receive more, some may receive less.'
Check payouts are voided if not claimed directly after the experiment — no re-issues.
Duration is a general range (1-1.5 hours); exact pay and duration are per-study on Sona.
Extra recruits may be turned away with only a show-up fee.

c1.evidence: Official Xlab FAQ confirms a paid program: 'The payout is given out by check directly after the experiment or virtually (Amazon.com), which may take longer.' (xlab.berkeley.edu/participate/FAQs.html)

c3.evidence: Same-day timing confirmed officially, but without a concrete payout the route cannot verify.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: Must sign up via Sona; attend the scheduled session; checks must be claimed directly after the experiment
maximize: Paid by check on the spot is fast, but the amount is only an average — check each experiment's Sona listing for its actual payout before signing up, and claim your check before you leave the lab or it is voided.
